Package com.j3d.engine.interact.macros

Class MacroUtils

java.lang.Object
com.j3d.engine.interact.macros.MacroUtils
public class MacroUtils extends Object
Da Macro Utils. Basically the single instance manager of all the macros in J3Engine, this class is responsible for:
  • Providing the entire set of macros from the user's macros folder and the keys map
  • Updating both ends when a new macro is added or a key is changed. Although thats specific to MacrosEditor
  • Removing all J3Key in the global KeyBindings when macros change and the same for the EngineFrame.getMacroJMenu() where the macros are clickable via the JMenu
  • Holding the single instances to the MacroRecorder and MacroRunner
It can be accessed via StaticRefs.getMacroUtils() at any time.
Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole
